toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

data.summary: For product headset-stand under demo-direct as of 2026-10-24, the 5% revenue-margin draft price is BRL 31.38 before discount and BRL 28.24 after a 10% discount. The undiscounted scenario meets the requested margin at 5.02% revenue margin with BRL 1.58 contribution. The discounted scenario turns contribution negative at BRL -1.25 and revenue margin -4.43%, so the discount does not retain the requested margin.
assumptions: Product and rule are demonstration/synthetic fixtures, not confirmed business data or a live marketplace rule.
All charges in the rule are applied on the revenue basis returned by the deterministic calculator: 10% channel fee, 0% tax, 0% advertising, plus BRL 2 fixed fee.
Failure provision is included per stored product data using the modeled 10% failure rate and full-print retry assumption.
The 10% discount is applied to the recommended list price from the undiscounted scenario.
limitations: Contribution is not net profit; overhead not present in stored costs is unmodeled.
Full-print retry assumption may overstate or understate real scrap cost.
Marketplace verification is unavailable; no current Shopee fees are included.
Demonstration inputs are synthetic and valid only for the stated demonstration window.
